description: The Software Programmer qualification trains individuals in fundamental programming principles, software development methodologies, and a specific programming language (Java, Python, HTML5, Kotlin or Go). It also includes essential skills in project management, requirements engineering, and general employability/life skills, and offers specialization through elective modules.
